items.name: familis
items.title: Familis style
items.description: Familis brand foundations: the Familis blue palette for light and dark themes, radius, Manrope headings, Inter text, JetBrains Mono code, Source Serif 4 for editorial content and the logo.

theme.font-serif: 'Source Serif 4 Variable', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', serif

items.name: font-inter
items.title: Inter
items.description: Inter for body text and interface content, set on the document as font-sans, with its italics.

items.name: font-manrope
items.title: Manrope
items.description: Manrope for headings, available as font-heading and applied to semantic h1 to h6 elements.

items.name: font-jetbrains-mono
items.title: JetBrains Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono for code and commands, available as font-mono and applied to code, kbd, samp and pre elements.

font.family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
